blockers: The two switches on each slingshot and the three under-apron trough position switches lack defensible individual contact centers. The available game views only locate the assemblies.
The factory schematic confirms four lamps on flash branch 1B, but the central pair shares a drawing region and the VPX supplies only one local proxy there. Keep those two middle positions open.

The factory diagrams identify the GI feeds and the first three ramp-chase phase circuits. The retained table provides 26 shown bulb meshes in its GI collection, but their complete socket count and assignment to the two playfield feeds are unverified. Chase strips use render segments. The actual number and placement of emitters per phase remain unresolved.
The reported locations are observed VPX centers or factory projections. Exact socket positions for the raised/rear lamps and hidden assemblies still need independent physical measurements.

conflicts.description: Printed p. 27 draws lamp 36 in both the backbox inset and the upper-left playfield. Its list and printed p. 49 identify a backbox lamp. The retained VPX uses lamp 36 for a playfield red cover and glow. The documented backbox lamp is retained. Fitment and quantity of any playfield sockets on this circuit remain unresolved. Resolution path: have an owner or restorer run the discrete lamp 36 test and trace the circuit at both the backbox and the lower end of the upper-left Transporter assembly.
